name: competency-record
title: Worker competency record
for_each: select id,code from employees where active order by code

sections.title: Employee
sections.sql: select code,name,site from employees where id=$1

sections.title: Role requirements
sections.sql: select role,skill,minimum_level,level,readiness,expires_on from competency_matrix where employee_id=$1 order by role,skill
sections.note: A record check is not authorisation to work.

sections.title: Assessment history
sections.sql: select code,level,assessed_on,expires_on,assessor,evidence,status,review_note from results where employee_id=$1 order by assessed_on

name: training-follow-up
title: Training follow-up working draft
for_each: select id,code from employees where active order by code

sections.title: Training actions
sections.sql: select t.code,s.name skill,t.owner,t.due_on,t.status,t.evidence from training t join skills s on s.id=t.skill_id where employee_id=$1 order by due_on
sections.note: Course completion does not approve a competency assessment.
